decision: Defer unspecified CLI. Identify one concrete future non-frozen consumer/input family before choosing its single adapter; this is not a new mandatory gate.

four_fields.mechanism: Both authors propose one additive real consumer delegating to the fit_development seam and preserving returned full/selected outputs. They differ in authority/input contracts.
four_fields.prediction: Actual authorized consumer delegates exactly once per declared arm and consumes returned selected count/model; invalid inputs fail before helper and exceptions never cause direct-fit or ceiling fallback.
four_fields.nearest_finite_check: A four actual-entrypoint native-free cases versus B three synthetic invocations, at most one spy; UNRUN/ungranted. Exact failure/consumed namespace cases need retained consumer-specific identity.
four_fields.task1_benefit: Practical automatic tree selection for an identified future training use. A new CLI is not intrinsically required by the existing callable/helper request.

A_models_a.verdict: Conditional integration refinement, not a necessary general CLI or a current implementation. Defer until a named future consumer uses public018-format inputs.
A_models_a.adapter: reproduce_frozen_comparison.prepare_matrix authenticated caller-owned exports, frozen B/W recipe, ordered recipe feature_names; not verify_collection.
failure_risks: No old both-fits-complete receipt for per-arm selection
Public source/recipe closure is frozen and cannot be silently reused as a new operation authority

B_features_a.verdict: Conditional one-fit v1 consumer refinement. Not a route for full original 26,000-query training unless separately supported input preparation exists.
B_features_a.adapter: verify_collection returns phase/refs/feature_columns/pins/plan from accepted exact v1 lineage; prepare_dataset derives names from report collection feature_columns through numeric_feature_names.
B_features_a.chronology_ledger_correction: Code equality label_available_before == fit_data_cutoff, not strict cutoff-before-label-bound inequality. model_timing equal across phases; fit < ready <= selection_start; config wall within declared gap.
failure_risks: Matching Prepared shape/features does not prove source lineage
No native integration from fake checks
